sources.notes: Official BOA Page | 2026-10-19: redirects to bankofamerica.com/credit-cards/ (product no longer listed).
PRESS (USA Today, 2026-05-04): BofA spokesperson says it is not accepting new Spirit card applications.
PRESS (TPG): BofA stopped accepting applications for both Free Spirit cards on May 2, 2026.
PRESS (NerdWallet, updated 2026-10-01): accounts being converted to BofA Customized Cash Rewards.
PRESS (Forbes Advisor): BofA spokesperson confirms transition to Customized Cash Rewards.

discontinued_notes: Closed to new applicants. Official: the Bank of America product page (bankofamerica.com/credit-cards/products/spirit-airlines-credit-card/) now redirects to the generic BofA credit card list (checked 2026-10-19). Press (not issuer pages): USA Today (2026-05-04, BofA spokesperson) and The Points Guy report BofA stopped accepting applications on 2026-05-02 after Spirit Airlines ceased operations; NerdWallet and Forbes Advisor report existing accounts are being converted to the BofA Customized Cash Rewards card (Unlimited Cash Rewards for existing Customized Cash holders).
